title: RAKU at the School!
evidence_sentence: The page states participants load and watch a glazed pot fire in a raku kiln, with pots pulled hot from the kiln.
evidence_quote: See the pot loaded in a raku kiln, fired and then pulled out while glowing hot!
summary: Public raku firing workshop where you glaze a pre-made pot and watch it fire in a raku kiln. Four dates available: September 19–20 and November 27–28, 1–4 pm. $30 includes one glazed pot and firing.
how_to_join: Select date and add to cart
